title: The Complete Tianji Record
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji saw the end of that River of Destiny, Destiny itself was watching him—and those eyes that transcended all things were the truth he had pursued through eight volumes.

text.content: In the moment the remnant soul scattered into countless motes of light, Chen Ji felt a warm power flood into his meridians—it was the final gift of Mo Xiansheng's thousand-year cultivation, and also the heaviest guardianship he was about to bear.

He knelt on one knee, palm pressed to his chest. The Tianji Sword hummed against his knee, and the four dim markings on the blade were lighting up in an unbelievable way—not appearing one by one, but blooming simultaneously, like four golden lotuses flourishing in the dark night.

dialogue.content: "Five pages unified... A thousand-year wait, finally repaid." Mo Xiansheng's voice came from deep within the sword, weak yet relieved. "Child, are you ready? The price of seeing the truth was never merely the Heavenly Fate Value."

text.content: Before the words finished, the Tianji Sword erupted with blinding light. Chen Ji instinctively closed his eyes, yet felt his consciousness being pulled from his body by an invisible force—he was falling toward something indescribable, piercing through clouds, through the firmament, through all boundaries of form and formlessness.

When he opened his eyes again, he found himself standing on a vast, boundless river. The water was pure black, yet flowed with countless points of light—each point was a thread of destiny, weaving, tangling, separating, reuniting, all flowing toward the same direction in the end.

This was the River of Destiny. The power of the Fifth Page had briefly freed him from destiny's shackles, allowing him to stand on the riverbank and gaze upon everything he should have had—and that endpoint already written for him.

Chen Ji lowered his head to find his own thread of destiny. Soon he found it—a thread so dim it was nearly gray, so humble among the countless brilliant points of light. He followed that thread forward and saw the seven hundredth point of light—a blood-red knot.

dialogue.content: Chapter Seven Hundred. He murmured to himself, his voice hoarse like rusted iron. To weave destiny in chapters—this Heavenly Eye truly saw him as a character in a tale.

text.content: He stared at that blood-red knot. Within the knot was sealed a scene—he saw his own death. Not the heroic sacrifice one might imagine, but the most humiliating demise: all essence and blood drained dry, soul crushed to nothing, body turned to void, as if he had never existed.

And the one who had arranged all this was a presence he had never seen yet knew intimately—those eyes. Suspended above the River of Destiny, gazing down at countless creatures as insignificant as ants, writing each person's ending with a coldness that transcended time.

The Heavenly Eye. Chen Ji spoke this name in his heart. It was not a person, not a sect, not any enemy that could be defeated. It was the will of this heaven and earth itself, the rule above all rule-makers, the author above all authors of destiny.

dialogue.content: "So the Tianji Record was never any treasure for defying heaven and changing fate." Chen Ji suddenly laughed, the sound echoing across the empty River of Destiny, carrying an indescribable mix of sorrow and mockery. "It was merely bait you placed in the world, specifically to attract fools like me to walk into the net."

text.content: The moment the words fell, those eyes moved. They slowly descended, passing countless threads of destiny, and looked directly at Chen Ji—not gazing down, but meeting at eye level. That gaze held no emotion whatsoever, yet Chen Ji felt his very soul being pierced through.
"Clever child." A voice sounded in his mind, ancient and calm. "But cleverness has never been a reason to survive. Those who defy heaven, heaven abandons. This is a rule, not a punishment."

Chen Ji felt something rapidly draining from within him. Heavenly Fate Value—as he used the Fifth Page's ability, Destiny itself was demanding payment. That dim thread of destiny belonging to him began to tremble, as if it might snap at any moment.

"Every glimpse of destiny accelerates the inevitable ending." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, this time filled with deep worry. "The Fifth Page's ability is a double-edged sword—the further you can see, the closer Death approaches."

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Eye's gaze and the death prophecy of Chapter Seven Hundred, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: No more evasion, no more endurance—directly confront the Heavenly Will and declare his existence
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Title "Destiny Defier"; the Heavenly Eye can no longer easily peer into your destiny
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may inflict punishment on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, gazing directly into those lofty eyes. He didn't know where his courage came from, but at this moment only one thought burned in his heart—since Destiny wanted him dead, he would damn well walk out of this river alive.

dialogue.content: "Did you see that?" Chen Ji spoke, his voice calm yet carrying an irresistible force. "Chapter 700 that you wrote—I saw it. Now, I will tear out this page with my own hands."

choices.description: Preserve strength, seal away the truth seen, and wait for a better opportunity
choices.visible_cost: Lose the Fifth Page ability (for this time)
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate, complete intelligence will be stored in the deep memory of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may lock onto your position

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to look away. He knew this was not the time for rashness—the Heavenly Eye had existed for countless ages, while he was merely a newly hatched ant who had just obtained the complete Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "I've noted it down." He silently recited in his heart. "Wait until I gather all the puzzle pieces, then I'll settle this score with you." With these words, he proactively severed his connection with the River of Destiny, his consciousness ebbing away like the tide.

choices.description: Since the death outcome has already been seen, proactively investigate the seal's structure and seek weaknesses
choices.visible_reward: Acquire critical intelligence: structural weakness of the seal
choices.risk_hint: May trigger direct attack from the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji extended his hand, his fingertip touching that blood-red knot. It felt ice-cold, yet an uncanny pulsation throbbed within. He focused his perception and discovered this seal was not impenetrable—its structure was complex and precise, but consequently possessed a fatal point of equilibrium.

dialogue.content: "So that's how it is..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly. "The reason this seal can lock my destiny is that it connects to the entire Heavenly Rules. To break it, my strength alone is far from sufficient—I need to overturn the entire world's operating laws."

text.content: The moment consciousness returned to his body, Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes. The Tianji Sword lay silently on his knee, the five markings on its blade now fully merged into a flowing golden light. He lowered his gaze to his hands—beneath his skin, something was slowly coursing through the faintly visible blood vessels.

That was Mo Xiansheng's thousand-year cultivation, merging into his body. At the same time, many memories not belonging to him filled his mind—the image of Mo Xiansheng in his youth, the complete process of him being chosen and then rejected, and the true reason he used his remnant soul to guard the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "Child." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out for the last time, this time carrying genuine relief. "Everything I should have told you is within those five pages. The remaining road... you must walk yourself. Remember, the Tianji Record is not a weapon—it is an eye. And true power..."

text.content: The voice gradually dissipated into the wind. Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Sword tightly, feeling that warm energy flowing through his meridians. The blade quivered lightly, as if responding to his state of mind. The five pages united, a thousand-year layout, finally completed its final puzzle piece in his hands.

He slowly rose, gazing toward the distant horizon. The clouds churned there, as if something was watching him. The aftereffects of the Heavenly Eye had not yet faded, but he was no longer that ignorant chess piece.

The structure of Chapter 700's seal had become clear. The operational mechanism of the Heavenly Eye also showed promising clues. Mo Xiansheng's memories told him the true third path was not impossible—only that path required a cost more terrifying than death.
And now, he had a choice.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record completely merged, truth within reach—how should Chen Ji continue?

choices.description: Strike while the iron is hot, test the complete functionality of the full Tianji Record, especially the special ability of the Fifth Page
choices.visible_reward: Unlock complete skill tree, obtain ability details
choices.risk_hint: May expose location to Eye of Heavenly Dao

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, placing the Tianji Sword across his knees. He closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking deep into the sword's core. The text from the five pages of the Tianji Record flowed before his eyes like water, every ability on each page, every line of taboo, crystal clear.

The complete Tianji Record contains seven core abilities: Foresight, Archive, Backtrack, Veil, Fusion, Jump, and the one he had just experienced - 'Step Out'. Each ability has its limits and conditions of use, and what he needed to do now was master them all.

choices.description: The sister is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the key to breaking the seal, must find her quickly
choices.visible_reward: Obtain vague clues about Chen Nian's location
choices.risk_hint: May be detected by Holy Sect and ambushed

dialogue.content: Chen Nian... His fingertips trembled slightly. In Mo Xiansheng's memories was a piece of deliberately hidden information: the function of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key was not only to disrupt prophecy, but to serve as the core material for breaking the fate seal.

text.content: If he wanted to tear away Chapter 700, he had to find his sister. And the Holy Sect was precisely the ones who took her. This meant he had to actively step into the Demonic Path's territory, and under the watchful gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, play the most dangerous move.

choices.memory_label: 寻找陈念成为首要目标

choices.description: The Demonic Path Saintess's 'Demonic Path Mist' can conceal the Tianji Record's aura, making her a key ally against the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Obtain 'Demonic Path Mist' protection, temporarily shield from Eye of Heavenly Dao's tracking
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may have other schemes

text.content: Chen Ji took out a black jade talisman from his bosom - the contact token Ye Qing had left when she departed. By infusing spiritual energy, he could establish contact with her. And now, he needed her ability to mask his own aura.

dialogue.content: "Cooperate?" he murmured to himself, the corners of his mouth lifting slightly, "No, this is mutual benefit. She helps me conceal the Tianji, I help her escape Holy Sect control. Each taking what they need, a fair trade."

choices.memory_label: 与夜清建立更深的合作关系

text.content: Just then, footsteps sounded in the distance. Chen Ji's brow furrowed, his hand already on his sword hilt - though the Tianji Record was complete, his combat power remained at the waste level. If the visitor was an enemy, with his current state, he might not be able to cope.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji?" Su Qingyao's voice came from behind the trees, carrying an incredulous tone, "You... why has your aura changed?" She stepped out of the shadows, her beautiful eyes filled with wariness, "What was that light just now?"

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. Su Qingyao was the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, her perceptive abilities far surpassed ordinary people, and the changes in the Tianji Record's aura would not escape her notice. But his expression remained calm as still water, even forcing out a bitter smile.

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister Su." He made a formal bow, his voice虚弱得恰到好处, "I'm not quite sure either... I was meditating in the forest when I suddenly felt dizzy, and when I woke up, it was like this. Perhaps an old illness has relapsed?"

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's gaze held scrutiny. Chen Ji needed to decide how to deal with this most sharp-eyed observer:

choices.description: "Adopt the persona of a useless person, pretend to know nothing, leaving Su Qingyao with no leads to investigate."
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain the status quo and keep the secret."
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao may become even more suspicious."

dialogue.content: "'Dizzy?' Su Qingyao stepped closer, her gaze sweeping over him. 'A Menial Servant like you, coming to a place like this? Don't tell me you came to gather herbs.'"

text.content: Chen Ji sneered in his heart, but his face showed only confusion: 'Replying to Senior Sister, this disciple really did come to gather herbs. The Rejuvenation Grass on the Back Mountain is about to wither. This disciple wanted to harvest some before it's too late...' He chattered on, acting thoroughly frightened.

choices.description: "Admit to having a fortuitous encounter, but hide the core secret, using Su Qingyao's curiosity to build a deeper connection."
choices.visible_reward: "Establish a deeper bond with Su Qingyao."
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao may pursue the matter to the end."

dialogue.content: "'Since Senior Sister asks...' Chen Ji deliberated for a moment, as if having made a great decision, 'This disciple did encounter something. But the matter is too significant. I ask Senior Sister to allow me to keep it confidential for now. If the opportunity arises in the future, I will certainly tell you the truth.'"

text.content: Su Qingyao's expression changed. She stared at Chen Ji for a long time, seemingly trying to find a flaw in his face. But in the end, she simply sighed lightly: 'Fine. If you won't say, I won't force you. It's just that...'

choices.memory_label: 与苏青瑶建立了秘密的信任

choices.description: "Use the new ability of the Tianji Record to see the imminent crisis Su Qingyao will face, proactively show goodwill to redirect her attention."
choices.visible_cost: "Consume one use of the Foresight Ability."
choices.visible_reward: "Su Qingyao will develop strong curiosity and trust toward you."

text.content: A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes—precisely as Su Qingyao approached, the Tianji Record automatically operated, showing him a vision: In three days, Su Qingyao would suffer a covert attack during the Sect Competition, gravely wounded and near death, and the mastermind was none other than Ling Yuan's confidant.

dialogue.content: "'Senior Sister Su.' Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable weight. 'During the Sect Competition three days from now, please be especially careful. If anyone invites you to spar at the Back Mountain Cliff... absolutely do not agree.'"

choices.memory_label: 向苏青瑶预警了她的危机

text.content: Night wind swept through the treetops, bringing coldness from the depths of distant mountains. Chen Ji stood there, gazing at Su Qingyao's departing figure, while his mind rapidly calculated. After the Tianji Record was complete, his Foresight Ability had increased severalfold, but the cost was also clearer—every glimpse into destiny was one step closer to death.

The seal of the Heavenly Eye still hung at the position of Chapter Seven Hundred, like a guillotine ready to fall at any moment. But he was no longer the chess piece to be manipulated—true power of the Five Pages as One was far more than simply seeing the future.

"'To break the prophecy of fate itself...' Chen Ji murmured to himself, a resolute gleam flickering in his eyes, 'one must invalidate the prophecy itself. And to invalidate the prophecy...' He gripped the Tianji Sword tightly, the golden light on its blade interweaving with the light in his eyes, 'one must make the Heavenly Eye watch with its own eyes as the ending it wrote gets torn apart.'"

In the distant clouds, something seemed to be watching all of this. Chen Ji looked up at the horizon, a faint smile curving his lips—a smile of one who knows the abyss lies ahead yet still chooses to stride forward.
The seal at Chapter Seven Hundred requires the third key to unlock. And that key, at this moment, quietly falls into his hand on the chessboard of destiny.

The back mountain of Tianqing Sect remained silent, but Chen Ji knew this silence would soon be broken. Ling Yuan would not let this go, Han Lie of Xuanwu Sect was sharpening their knives, and the shadow of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path was stirring. And he, had to place all the pieces in their proper positions before these storms arrived.

After the Tianji Record was complete, he saw his chessboard clearly for the first time: the overt and covert struggles of the three major sects, the true purpose of the Demonic Path invasion, the method to open the Ancient Forbidden Land, and the Heavenly Dao Will hidden behind everything. All threads converged in his hands, just one step away—pulling fate itself off the chessboard.

"Heavenly Secrets Eye..." Chen Ji repeated this name, his gaze profound as an abyss. "You've chosen the wrong piece." He turned and walked toward the mountain, his silhouette stretching long under the moonlight, like a silent declaration—the war between chess player and chess piece officially begins tonight.

Far above the nine heavens, those eyes that transcended everything still watched it all. It held no anger, no anxiety, only eternal tranquility. Because in its understanding, all ants who dared to defy heaven would ultimately fail to escape destruction.

But perhaps it forgot—even ants are small, yet they can collapse a dam. The completion of the Tianji Record not only granted Chen Ji the ability to foresee fate, but let him see a truth: the Heavenly Secrets Eye was not invincible, it was simply the first ant in countless years who dared to look it straight in the eye.

When Chen Ji stepped into the night, the Tianji Sword at his waist grew warm. The true power of the five pages reuniting was completely awakened at this moment—it was no longer merely a fragmentary prophecy, but a key to rewriting fate. However, every use of this key would come at the cost of his own life.

But so what? He had already seen his own death ending, what was there to fear? If fate destined him to die in chapter seven hundred, then he would use these 198 chapters to weave a net from which even heaven could not escape.
When Chen Ji saw the end of that river of fate, fate itself was also watching him—and those eyes transcending everything were precisely the truth he had pursued through eight volumes.
